segments.label: NEWS
segments.headline: Robots that learn from one demo

beats.narration: A new coworker can learn a task from seeing it once, but robots usually need hours or days of examples.
So can a robot learn a new job from just one demonstration?
A new company says yes: a person shows the robot a task once, then steps back.
And the robot does it on its own, with objects it has never seen.
In an hour-long test, its robots placed a block seventy-four times out of seventy-four.
If that holds up, teaching a robot becomes as quick as showing it once.

visual.text: Teach a robot by showing it once
